namespace M::MOGG {

/// Resolves kernel parameters (P0, P1, ...) from the opaque type parameters
/// (S0, S1, ...) on operands and results, via the kernel's annotations:
///   mogg.value_params: [{S0 = #kgen.param.decl.ref<P0>, ...}, ...]
///   mogg.value_result_params: [{S0 = #kgen.param.decl.ref<P0>, ...}]
void inferOpaqueParameters(SmallVectorImpl<NamedAttribute> &forwardedParameters,
                           Operation *moOp,
                           const KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor &function,
                           mlir::ArrayAttr inputParams) {
  auto inputParamsAttr = function.attr.getArgParams();
  auto resultParamsAttr = function.attr.getResultParams();

  // Explicitly declared parameters only (e.g. "P0" from "[P0: Int]"); a
  // backtick marks an inferred one (e.g. "S1`2x1" from a "_" placeholder).
  llvm::DenseSet<StringRef> declaredParams;
  if (inputParams) {
    for (auto paramAttr : inputParams) {
      if (auto param = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamDeclAttr>(paramAttr)) {
        StringRef paramName = param.getName();
        if (!paramName.contains('`'))
          declaredParams.insert(paramName);
      }
    }
  }

  auto inferFromOpaque = [&](DictionaryAttr kernelParamDict,
                             MO::OpaqueType opaqueType) {
    if (!kernelParamDict || !opaqueType)
      return;

    DictionaryAttr opaqueParams = opaqueType.getParameters();
    if (!opaqueParams)
      return;

    for (NamedAttribute kernelParam : kernelParamDict) {
      auto declRef = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr>(kernelParam.getValue());
      if (!declRef)
        continue;

      StringRef paramName = declRef.getName();
      if (!declaredParams.contains(paramName))
        continue;

      // Same key as in the opaque type (e.g. "S0").
      auto opaqueValue = opaqueParams.getNamed(kernelParam.getName());
      if (!opaqueValue)
        continue;

      auto typedValue = dyn_cast<TypedAttr>(opaqueValue->getValue());
      if (!typedValue)
        continue;

      forwardedParameters.push_back(
          NamedAttribute(declRef.getName(), typedValue));
    }
  };

  // Kernel arguments list DPS outputs first, then inputs; MO operands are
  // only the inputs.
  if (inputParamsAttr) {
    unsigned numDpsOutputs =
        static_cast<unsigned>(function.outputArguments.size());

    for (auto [idx, operand] : llvm::enumerate(moOp->getOperands())) {
      unsigned kernelArgIdx = idx + numDpsOutputs;
      if (kernelArgIdx >= inputParamsAttr.size())
        break;

      auto opaqueType = dyn_cast<MO::OpaqueType>(operand.getType());
      if (!opaqueType)
        continue;

      auto kernelParamDict =
          dyn_cast<DictionaryAttr>(inputParamsAttr[kernelArgIdx]);
      inferFromOpaque(kernelParamDict, opaqueType);
    }
  }

  if (!resultParamsAttr)
    return;

  for (auto [idx, result] : llvm::enumerate(moOp->getResults())) {
    if (idx >= resultParamsAttr.size())
      break;

    auto opaqueType = dyn_cast<MO::OpaqueType>(result.getType());
    if (!opaqueType)
      continue;

    auto kernelParamDict = dyn_cast<DictionaryAttr>(resultParamsAttr[idx]);
    inferFromOpaque(kernelParamDict, opaqueType);
  }
}

/// Removes parameters from inferByInputs that appear in the function's result
/// type but not in its input argument types.
static void removeResultOnlyParams(KGEN::LIT::FnTypeGeneratorType sig,
                                   llvm::DenseSet<StringRef> &inferByInputs) {
  SmallVector<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr> resultParamRefs;
  bool hasConstExpr = false;
  size_t requiredSignatureDepth = 0;
  Type userResultType = sig.getUserResultType();
  KGEN::collectParameterReferences(userResultType, resultParamRefs,
                                   hasConstExpr, requiredSignatureDepth);
  llvm::DenseSet<StringRef> resultParams;
  for (auto paramRef : resultParamRefs)
    resultParams.insert(paramRef.getName().getValue());

  // Excludes the byref result slot.
  ArrayRef<Type> argTypes = sig.getArguments();
  if (sig.hasMemoryOnlyResult())
    argTypes = argTypes.drop_back();
  if (sig.isThrows())
    argTypes = argTypes.drop_back();

  llvm::DenseSet<StringRef> inputParams;
  for (Type argType : argTypes) {
    SmallVector<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr> argParamRefs;
    KGEN::collectParameterReferences(argType, argParamRefs, hasConstExpr,
                                     requiredSignatureDepth);
    for (auto paramRef : argParamRefs)
      inputParams.insert(paramRef.getName().getValue());
  }

  SmallVector<StringRef> toRemove;
  for (StringRef paramName : inferByInputs) {
    if (resultParams.contains(paramName) && !inputParams.contains(paramName))
      toRemove.push_back(paramName);
  }
  for (StringRef paramName : toRemove)
    inferByInputs.erase(paramName);
}

/// Shared by all inferKernelParameters overloads.
static ErrorOr<InferredParameters>
inferParameters(ArrayRef<mlir::Attribute> fnLevelParams,
                ArrayRef<mlir::Attribute> structLevelParams,
                mlir::ArrayAttr inputParamMappings,
                mlir::DictionaryAttr defaultAttrs,
                KGEN::LIT::FnTypeGeneratorType sig,
                std::function<ErrorOr<MojoValue>(StringRef)> &inferCallback) {

  // A param is inferable from inputs when an argument type references it, as
  // a `ParamDeclRefAttr` or a depth-0 `ParamIndexRefAttr` (elaborated
  // bytecode's form). An IndexRef `*(0, K)` indexes the generator's full
  // parameter list, laid out as `structLevelParams + fnLevelParams`, so look
  // it up in the merged list; `fnLevelParams` alone would name the wrong
  // param.
  llvm::SmallVector<mlir::Attribute> mergedParams;
  mergedParams.reserve(structLevelParams.size() + fnLevelParams.size());
  mergedParams.append(structLevelParams.begin(), structLevelParams.end());
  mergedParams.append(fnLevelParams.begin(), fnLevelParams.end());

  llvm::DenseSet<StringRef> inferByInputs;
  std::function<void(mlir::Attribute)> walkAttr;
  std::function<void(mlir::Type)> walkType;
  walkAttr = [&](mlir::Attribute attr) {
    if (!attr)
      return;
    if (auto sugar = dyn_cast<KGEN::SugarAttr>(attr)) {
      walkAttr(sugar.getCanonical());
      return;
    }
    if (auto declRef = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr>(attr)) {
      inferByInputs.insert(declRef.getName().getValue());
      return;
    }
    if (auto indexRef = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamIndexRefAttr>(attr)) {
      if (indexRef.getDepth() == 0 &&
          indexRef.getIndex() < mergedParams.size()) {
        auto pd = cast<KGEN::ParamDeclAttr>(mergedParams[indexRef.getIndex()]);
        inferByInputs.insert(pd.getName().getValue());
      }
      return;
    }
    attr.walkImmediateSubElements([&](mlir::Attribute a) { walkAttr(a); },
                                  [&](mlir::Type t) { walkType(t); });
  };
  walkType = [&](mlir::Type type) {
    if (!type)
      return;
    type.walkImmediateSubElements([&](mlir::Attribute a) { walkAttr(a); },
                                  [&](mlir::Type t) { walkType(t); });
  };
  for (size_t i = 0, n = sig.getNumArguments(); i < n; ++i)
    walkType(sig.getArgument(i));

  removeResultOnlyParams(sig, inferByInputs);

  // Infer-only parameters (declared before `//`) are left for Mojo to infer
  // at the call. The walk above can miss one: a `TypeList` that a
  // `xs: TensorTuple[*Ts]` argument unpacks is referenced only through its
  // values.
  llvm::DenseSet<StringRef> inferOnly;
  if (KGEN::PogListAttr pogs = sig.getParamListAttrs())
    for (size_t i = 0, n = pogs.size(); i < n; ++i)
      if (pogs.getPassingKind(i) == KGEN::PassingKind::Inferred)
        inferOnly.insert(pogs.getName(i).getValue());

  auto isIOSpecType = [](Type ty) {
    auto structType = dyn_cast<KGEN::LIT::StructType>(ty);
    return structType &&
           isMojoIOSpecTypeName(structType.getSymbol().getNestedReferences());
  };

  auto inferParametersInner =
      [&](ArrayRef<mlir::Attribute> params,
          SmallVector<MojoValue> &inferredParams) -> ErrorOrSuccess {
    for (auto paramAttr : params) {
      auto param = cast<KGEN::ParamDeclAttr>(paramAttr);
      StringRef paramName = param.getName().getValue();

      if (isa<KGEN::LIT::OriginType>(param.getType()) ||
          isIOSpecType(param.getType()))
        continue;
      if (paramName.contains("."))
        continue;

      ErrorOr<MojoValue> maybeVal = inferCallback(paramName);
      if ((inferByInputs.contains(paramName) ||
           inferOnly.contains(paramName)) &&
          maybeVal.isError())
        continue;

      if (maybeVal.isError()) {
        if (defaultAttrs && defaultAttrs.contains(paramName))
          continue;
        return maybeVal.takeError();
      }
      inferredParams.push_back(MojoValue(paramName).equal(*maybeVal));
    }
    return success();
  };

  InferredParameters ret;
  auto errOr = inferParametersInner(fnLevelParams, ret.functionParameters);
  if (errOr.isError())
    return errOr.takeError();
  errOr = inferParametersInner(structLevelParams, ret.structParameters);
  if (errOr.isError())
    return errOr.takeError();
  return ret;
}

// {param-name -> UnitAttr} for fn-level params with a declared default, from
// the function's `PogListAttr`; such params may fail to infer.
static mlir::DictionaryAttr
computeDefaultParamsDict(KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor *fnAdaptor) {
  if (!fnAdaptor || !fnAdaptor->attr.getParams() ||
      fnAdaptor->attr.getParams().empty())
    return nullptr;
  auto fnParams = fnAdaptor->attr.getParams().getValue();
  KGEN::PogListAttr pogs = fnAdaptor->attr.getSignature().getParamListAttrs();
  size_t numImplicit =
      fnAdaptor->attr.getSignature().getNumImplicitOriginDecls();
  size_t totalPogs = pogs.getPogs().size();
  // Fn-level params are at the end of the merged pog list (struct-level
  // params come first).
  size_t fnStart =
      totalPogs >= fnParams.size() ? totalPogs - fnParams.size() : 0;
  size_t fnEnd =
      fnParams.size() > numImplicit ? fnParams.size() - numImplicit : 0;

  mlir::Builder builder(fnAdaptor->attr.getSignature().getContext());
  mlir::NamedAttrList defaultNames;
  for (size_t fnIdx = 0; fnIdx < fnEnd; ++fnIdx) {
    size_t pogIdx = fnStart + fnIdx;
    if (pogIdx >= totalPogs || !pogs.getDefault(pogIdx))
      continue;
    auto paramDecl = mlir::cast<KGEN::ParamDeclAttr>(fnParams[fnIdx]);
    defaultNames.append(
        mlir::StringAttr::get(
            fnAdaptor->attr.getSignature().getContext(),
            KGEN::demangleParameterName(paramDecl.getName().strref())),
        builder.getUnitAttr());
  }
  if (defaultNames.empty())
    return nullptr;
  return mlir::DictionaryAttr::get(fnAdaptor->attr.getSignature().getContext(),
                                   defaultNames.getAttrs());
}

ErrorOr<InferredParameters> inferKernelParameters(
    KernelDeclAdaptor &adaptor, llvm::StringRef funcLabel,
    std::function<ErrorOr<MojoValue>(StringRef)> &&inferCallback) {
  KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor *fnAdaptor =
      const_cast<KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor *>(
          adaptor.getFunctionByLabel(funcLabel));
  ASSERT_STREAM(fnAdaptor,
                "Function label '" << funcLabel << "' not found in adaptor");

  // Each variant (execute / elementwise / shape / build_graph) has its own
  // param list, since signatures differ (e.g. elementwise omits
  // `target`/`_trace_name`).
  ArrayRef<mlir::Attribute> fnParams;
  if (fnAdaptor->attr.getParams())
    fnParams = fnAdaptor->attr.getParams().getValue();

  ArrayRef<mlir::Attribute> structParams;
  if (adaptor.structParams)
    structParams = adaptor.structParams.getValue();

  // Defaults are declared on the execute signature (`execute_device`'s, for a
  // declarative kernel), except that `execute_configuration` declares its own.
  KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor *defaultsFn =
      funcLabel == kMoggExecuteConfigurationFunctionLabel
          ? fnAdaptor
          : (adaptor.executeFunction ? &*adaptor.executeFunction : nullptr);
  mlir::DictionaryAttr defaultParams = computeDefaultParamsDict(defaultsFn);
  return inferParameters(fnParams, structParams, fnAdaptor->attr.getArgParams(),
                         defaultParams, fnAdaptor->attr.getSignature(),
                         inferCallback);
}

ErrorOr<InferredParameters> inferKernelParameters(
    PrimitiveDeclOp primDecl,
    std::function<ErrorOr<MojoValue>(StringRef)> &&inferCallback) {
  MOGG::KernelFunctionAttr fn = primDecl.getFunction();
  return inferParameters(fn.getParams().getValue(),
                         /*structLevelParams=*/{}, fn.getArgParams(),
                         /*defaultAttrs=*/nullptr, fn.getSignature(),
                         inferCallback);
}

ErrorOr<InferredParameters> inferKernelParameters(
    ShapeFunctionDeclOp shapeDecl,
    std::function<ErrorOr<MojoValue>(StringRef)> &&inferCallback) {
  MOGG::KernelFunctionAttr fn = shapeDecl.getFunction();
  return inferParameters(fn.getParams().getValue(),
                         /*structLevelParams=*/{}, fn.getArgParams(),
                         /*defaultAttrs=*/nullptr, fn.getSignature(),
                         inferCallback);
}

namespace {

class MOFDriverOptions : public DriverOptions,
                         public MO::GraphCompilerOptions {};

/// Union of configuration gathered from MOFContext::setConfigs().
struct MOFConfig {
  SmallVector<std::string> kernelLibraryPaths;
  std::optional<std::string> defaultDeviceLabel;
  std::optional<size_t> deviceID;
  std::optional<DeviceSpec> deviceSpec;
  bool tileBasedFusion = false;

  void overrideLoweringOptions(MO::GCPipelineOptions &gcPipelineOptions) const {
    gcPipelineOptions.compiledFrameworkLabel =
        CompiledFrameworkLabel::asLabelString(
            CompiledFrameworkLabel::kModularModel);
    gcPipelineOptions.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
    if (defaultDeviceLabel) {
      gcPipelineOptions.defaultDeviceLabel = *defaultDeviceLabel;
      if (deviceID)
        gcPipelineOptions.defaultDeviceId = *deviceID;
    }
    gcPipelineOptions.defaultDeviceTargetTriple =
        deviceSpec ? deviceSpec.value().target.triple.str() : "";
    gcPipelineOptions.defaultDeviceTargetArch =
        deviceSpec ? deviceSpec.value().target.arch : "";
  }
};

} // namespace

struct MOFContext::Impl final {
  ContextRef maxContext;
  std::unique_ptr<MOFDriverOptions> clOptions;
  const DriverOptions *driverOptions{nullptr};
  std::unique_ptr<MO::GraphCompilerCLOptions> graphCompilerParser;
  std::unique_ptr<MOFConfig> mofConfig;
  bool optionsParsed{false};

  const CommonOptions *getCommonCLOptions() const {
    return driverOptions ? static_cast<const CommonOptions *>(driverOptions)
                         : clOptions.get();
  }

  bool getEnableMEFMetadata() const {
    return driverOptions ? driverOptions->enableMEFMetadata
                         : (clOptions ? clOptions->enableMEFMetadata : true);
  }
};

/// Constructor when invoking from command line.
MOFContext::MOFContext(ContextRef maxContext, int &argc, char **&argv)
    : impl(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {
  impl->maxContext = std::move(maxContext);
  impl->clOptions = std::make_unique<MOFDriverOptions>();
  impl->driverOptions = impl->clOptions.get();
  impl->clOptions->programName = argv[0];
  (void)argc;
  impl->graphCompilerParser =
      std::make_unique<MO::GraphCompilerCLOptions>(*impl->clOptions);
}

/// Constructor when invoking via API.
MOFContext::MOFContext(ContextRef maxContext) : impl(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {
  impl->maxContext = std::move(maxContext);
}

MOFContext::~MOFContext() = default;

const ExecutorDriverOptions *MOFContext::getExecutorDriverOptions() const {
  return impl->driverOptions
             ? static_cast<const ExecutorDriverOptions *>(impl->driverOptions)
             : impl->clOptions.get();
}

void MOFContext::setDriverOptions(const DriverOptions &options) {
  impl->driverOptions = &options;
}

ErrorOrSuccess MOFContext::setOptions(ArrayRef<std::string> opts) {
  if (opts.empty())
    return success();

  if (!impl->clOptions)
    return Error("CL Options parser is not initialized");

  if (impl->optionsParsed)
    return success();

  for (StringRef opt : opts) {
    const char *optChars[] = {impl->clOptions->getProgramName().data(),
                              opt.data()};
    if (!llvm::cl::ParseCommandLineOptions(std::size(optChars), optChars))
      return Error("unable to parse argument: " + opt);
  }

  impl->optionsParsed = true;
  return success();
}

ErrorOrSuccess
MOFContext::setConfigs(ArrayRef<std::unique_ptr<DriverConfig>> configs) {
  auto &mofConfig = impl->mofConfig;
  if (!mofConfig)
    mofConfig = std::make_unique<MOFConfig>();

  for (auto &driverConfig : configs) {
    if (auto kernelLibraryConfig =
            dyn_cast<KernelLibraryDriverConfig>(driverConfig.get())) {
      mofConfig->kernelLibraryPaths.push_back(
          kernelLibraryConfig->getPath().string());
    } else if (auto deviceConfig = dyn_cast<DeviceConfig>(driverConfig.get())) {
      mofConfig->defaultDeviceLabel = deviceConfig->getDeviceLabel();
      mofConfig->deviceID = deviceConfig->getDeviceID();
      mofConfig->deviceSpec = deviceConfig->deviceSpec;
    } else if (auto tileBasedFusionConfig =
                   dyn_cast<TileBasedFusionDriverConfig>(driverConfig.get())) {
      mofConfig->tileBasedFusion = tileBasedFusionConfig->getTileBasedFusion();
    }
  }
  return success();
}

void MOFContext::overrideLoweringOptions(
    MO::GCPipelineOptions &gcPipelineOptions) {
  if (impl->driverOptions)
    gcPipelineOptions.minimumCpuAlignment =
        impl->driverOptions->minimumCpuAlignment;
  if (impl->clOptions)
    static_cast<const MO::GraphCompilerOptions &>(*impl->clOptions)
        .overrideLoweringOptions(gcPipelineOptions);
  gcPipelineOptions.compiledFrameworkLabel =
      CompiledFrameworkLabel::asLabelString(
          CompiledFrameworkLabel::kModularModel);
  if (impl->mofConfig)
    impl->mofConfig->overrideLoweringOptions(gcPipelineOptions);

  if (auto configOr = M::Config::open(); !configOr.isError()) {
    if (configOr->getValueAsBool("max-debug.nan-check", false))
      gcPipelineOptions.nanCheck = true;
    StringRef strideStr = configOr->getValue("max-debug.nan-check-stride");
    if (!strideStr.empty()) {
      uint64_t stride = 0;
      if (!strideStr.getAsInteger(/*radix=*/10, stride) && stride > 0)
        gcPipelineOptions.nanCheckStride = static_cast<size_t>(stride);
    }

    if (configOr->getValueAsBool("max-debug.profile-scope-tracing", false))
      gcPipelineOptions.enableProfileScopeTracing = true;
    if (configOr->getValueAsBool(
            "max-debug.profile-scope-tracing-trace-unlabelled", false))
      gcPipelineOptions.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled = true;

    if (configOr->getValueAsBool("max-debug.pre-jit", false))
      gcPipelineOptions.preJit = true;

    // mo-opt's flag doesn't reach the in-process Python compile path.
    StringRef timingOutDir =
        configOr->getValue("max-debug.mlir-timing-out-dir");
    if (!timingOutDir.empty())
      gcPipelineOptions.mlirTimingOutDir = timingOutDir.str();
  }
}

/// Prints the first error diagnostic (like the first Python exception) with a
/// Python stacktrace from the graph api location, else falls back to
/// FormatScopedDiagnosticHandler.
class GraphApiDiagnosticHandler : public mlir::ScopedDiagnosticHandler {
public:
  GraphApiDiagnosticHandler(MLIRContext *ctx)
      : ScopedDiagnosticHandler(ctx, [&](Diagnostic &diag) {
          diagnostics.push_back(std::move(diag));
        }) {}

  std::string formatMessage() const {
    std::string message;
    llvm::raw_string_ostream messageStream(message);
    emitDiagnosticToStream(messageStream);
    return message;
  }

private:
  std::vector<mlir::Diagnostic> diagnostics;

  void emitDiagnosticToStream(raw_ostream &os) const {
    auto errorDiagnostics =
        llvm::make_filter_range(diagnostics, [](const Diagnostic &diag) {
          return diag.getSeverity() == mlir::DiagnosticSeverity::Error;
        });
    if (errorDiagnostics.empty()) {
      // Still use fallback diagnostics when there are no errors.
      emitFallbackDiagnosticsToStream(os);
      return;
    }

    for (const Diagnostic &diag : errorDiagnostics) {
      // Python op creation attaches the user call stack to the location
      // (graph.py `_location()` -> `_graph.frame_loc()`).
      if (auto attr = RMO::PythonFrameAttr::fromLocation(diag.getLocation())) {
        os << "\nSource Traceback:\n"
           // Formatted via Python's traceback.format_list.
           << attr.stack_trace() << '\n';
      }
      FormatScopedDiagnosticHandler::emitDiagnosticSeverityToStream(os, diag);

      for (const Diagnostic &note : diag.getNotes()) {
        // Skip notes that would dump the op's IR, judged by the first
        // argument (typically the message).
        if (note.getArguments().empty() ||
            note.getArguments().front().getKind() !=
                mlir::DiagnosticArgument::DiagnosticArgumentKind::String ||
            !note.getArguments().front().getAsString().starts_with(
                "see current operation")) {
          FormatScopedDiagnosticHandler::emitDiagnosticToStream(os, note);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  void emitFallbackDiagnosticsToStream(raw_ostream &os) const {
    int pid = llvm::sys::Process::getProcessId();
    std::string fileName = "max-full-diagnostics-" + Twine(pid).str();

    auto diagFile = TempFile::create(fileName);
    if (diagFile.isError()) {
      os << "Error creating file for full diagnostics (" << fileName
         << "): " << diagFile.takeError() << "\n"
         << "All diagnostics will be emitted to the console.\n";
      for (auto &diag : diagnostics)
        FormatScopedDiagnosticHandler::emitDiagnosticToStream(os, diag);
      return;
    }

    // Minimal console output; everything goes to a file.
    diagFile->keep();
    std::error_code unused;
    llvm::raw_fd_ostream fullOutputStream(diagFile->getPath().c_str(), unused);

    std::string previousDiagnostic;
    for (auto &diag : diagnostics) {
      std::string currentDiagnostic;
      llvm::raw_string_ostream currentDiagnosticStream(currentDiagnostic);
      FormatScopedDiagnosticHandler::emitDiagnosticToStream(
          currentDiagnosticStream, fullOutputStream, diag);

      if (currentDiagnostic == previousDiagnostic)
        continue;
      previousDiagnostic = currentDiagnostic;
      os << currentDiagnostic << "\n";
    }

    os << "================================================\n";
    os << "Elided diagnostics have been emitted to "
       << diagFile->getPath().c_str() << "\n";
    os << "================================================\n";
  }
};

/// Sinks the `tile_based_fusion` compile option into every
/// `mo.device_info_mapping` entry, CPU included, so SIMD can later become a
/// subset of TileTensor.
static void enableTileBasedFusion(ModuleOp moduleOp) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = moduleOp.getContext();
  auto dict =
      moduleOp->getAttrOfType<DictionaryAttr>(MO::DeviceInfoMapping::kAttrName);
  if (!dict)
    return;

  SmallVector<NamedAttribute> entries;
  entries.reserve(dict.size());
  bool changed = false;
  for (NamedAttribute entry : dict) {
    auto info = dyn_cast<DeviceInfoAttr>(entry.getValue());
    if (info && !info.getTileBasedFusion()) {
      entries.emplace_back(entry.getName(),
                           DeviceInfoAttr::get(ctx, info.getLabel(),
                                               info.getApi(), info.getArch(),
                                               info.getModel(),
                                               /*tile_based_fusion=*/true));
      changed = true;
    } else {
      entries.push_back(entry);
    }
  }

  if (changed)
    moduleOp->setAttr(MO::DeviceInfoMapping::kAttrName,
                      DictionaryAttr::get(ctx, entries));
}

/// Lowers a module op to MGP then exports to MEF.
static ErrorOr<BufferRef> convertMOToMEF(ModuleOp moduleOp,
                                         const MO::GCPipelineOptions &options,
                                         bool enableMEFMetadata) {
  bool const dumpStages = !getMaxIRDumpDir().empty();
  GraphApiDiagnosticHandler diagnostics(moduleOp.getContext());
  if (failed(MO::runGCPipeline(moduleOp, options, dumpStages)))
    return Error(Twine("Graph compilation failed:\n") +
                 diagnostics.formatMessage());

  // Nothing to export without the JIT; erroring also keeps the half-lowered
  // result out of the MEF cache. emit-mojo already wrote the Mojo.
  if (options.preJit)
    return Error("compilation stopped after emitting Mojo, as requested by "
                 "pre-jit; the emitted Mojo is in ir-output-dir");

  auto bufOr = MO::convertMGPToMEF(moduleOp, enableMEFMetadata);
  if (bufOr)
    return bufOr.takeError();
  return bufOr.takeValue();
}

M::ErrorOr<M::BufferRef> MOFContext::compileToBinary(void *source,
                                                     FileFormat format) {
  // Cheap: weights are dense_resource attributes owned by the MLIRContext.
  OwningOpRef<ModuleOp> moduleOp =
      ModuleOp::getFromOpaquePointer(source).clone();

  auto &maxContext = impl->maxContext;
  MLIRContext *mlirCtx = moduleOp->getContext();
  registerContext(*mlirCtx, maxContext);

  auto telemetryContext = maxContext->get<GML::MaxEngineTelemetryContext>();

  // Must precede the telemetry diagnostic handler.
  llvm::SourceMgr sourceMgr;
  mlir::SourceMgrDiagnosticHandler diagHandler(sourceMgr, mlirCtx);

  GML::MaxEngineTelemetryScope<GML::MaxEngineErrorCode::GraphLoweringError>
      loweringDiagScope(mlirCtx, telemetryContext);

  // Gather all the options from all the sources.
  MO::GCPipelineOptions gcPipelineOptions;
  overrideLoweringOptions(gcPipelineOptions);

  // Set iff Python `Analysis::seed_kernel_decls` already seeded kernel decls,
  // so mogg-import-packages can be skipped.
  if ((*moduleOp)->hasAttr(MOGG::kOpaqueTypeMappingAttrName))
    gcPipelineOptions.kernelDeclsPrePopulated = true;

  // Before the cache key, so tile and non-tile compiles never collide.
  if (impl->mofConfig && impl->mofConfig->tileBasedFusion)
    enableTileBasedFusion(*moduleOp);

  bool enableMEFMetadata = impl->getEnableMEFMetadata();

  auto baseCacheDirOr = M::getMaxCacheDir();

  if (!isModelIRCacheEnabled() || !baseCacheDirOr)
    return convertMOToMEF(*moduleOp, gcPipelineOptions, enableMEFMetadata);

  const std::filesystem::path &baseCacheDir = *baseCacheDirOr;
  auto mefBackendOr = Cache::getLocalDefaultBackendChain(
      (baseCacheDir / "mof" / "mef").string(),
      std::string(M::getModularVersionString()));

  if (mefBackendOr.isError()) {
    return convertMOToMEF(*moduleOp, gcPipelineOptions, enableMEFMetadata);
  }

  auto keyHashOr = computeMEFCacheKey(*moduleOp, gcPipelineOptions, maxContext);
  if (keyHashOr.isError())
    return keyHashOr.takeError();
  std::string keyHash = keyHashOr.takeValue();

  auto mefCache = RCRef<Cache::TransformCache>::create(*mefBackendOr);
  auto maybeMefOr = mefCache->findKeyedSync(keyHash);
  if (maybeMefOr.isError())
    return maybeMefOr.takeError();
  std::optional<BufferRef> maybeMef = maybeMefOr.takeValue();
  if (maybeMef) {
    auto onHitLambda = Cache::CacheTelemetryContext::getTelemetryOnHitLambda(
        "mof::M_compileToBinaryFromSource");
    onHitLambda(*moduleOp);

    return std::move(*maybeMef);
  }

  auto onMissLambda = Cache::CacheTelemetryContext::getTelemetryOnMissLambda(
      "mof::M_compileToBinaryFromSource",
      "mof.compiletobinaryfromsource.cache.miss.time",
      {{"pipeline", "mof::M_compileToBinaryFromSource"}});
  onMissLambda(*moduleOp);

  auto outBufOr =
      convertMOToMEF(*moduleOp, gcPipelineOptions, enableMEFMetadata);
  if (outBufOr.isError())
    return outBufOr.takeError();
  BufferRef outputBuffer = outBufOr.takeValue();

  // Insertion failure is ignored.
  (void)mefCache->insertKeyedSync(keyHash, outputBuffer.copy());

  return outputBuffer;
}

ErrorOr<M::BufferRef> MOFContext::compileToBinary(M::BufferRef file,
                                                  FileFormat format) {
  CompileToBinaryCtx compileCtx(impl->maxContext.copy());
  auto telemetryContext =
      impl->maxContext->get<GML::MaxEngineTelemetryContext>();
  // Gather all the options from all the sources.
  MO::GCPipelineOptions gcPipelineOptions;
  overrideLoweringOptions(gcPipelineOptions);

  MOGG::GraphCompilerCacheKey graphCompilerOptions{&compileCtx.mlirCtx};

  auto loweringTransform =
      [&, file = file.copy()]() mutable -> ErrorOr<BufferRef> {
    switch (format) {
    case FileFormat::kMODialect:
      [[fallthrough]];
    case FileFormat::kMGPDialect:
      compileCtx.module = parseMODialect(file.copy(), &compileCtx.mlirCtx);
      break;

    default: {
      auto identityOr = getFileContentIdentity(file.copy(), format);
      if (identityOr.isError())
        return identityOr.takeError();
      return Error("cannot compile input with format " + *identityOr);
    }
    }

    GML::MaxEngineTelemetryScope<GML::MaxEngineErrorCode::GraphLoweringError>
        loweringDiagScope(&compileCtx.mlirCtx, telemetryContext);

    switch (format) {
    case FileFormat::kMODialect: {
      GraphApiDiagnosticHandler diagnostics(&compileCtx.mlirCtx);
      if (failed(runGcPipeline(compileCtx.module.get(), gcPipelineOptions)))
        return Error(Twine("Graph compilation failed") +
                     diagnostics.formatMessage());
      format = FileFormat::kMGPDialect;
      break;
    }
    case FileFormat::kMGPDialect: {
      break;
    }
    default:
      auto identityOr = getFileContentIdentity(file.copy(), format);
      if (identityOr.isError())
        return identityOr.takeError();
      auto identity = std::move(*identityOr);
      return Error("cannot lower to MEF data of format " + identity);
    }

    return MO::convertMGPToMEF(compileCtx.module.get(),
                               impl->getEnableMEFMetadata());
  };

  // Custom kernels would have to be inspected for the key; don't cache.
  if (!gcPipelineOptions.kernelLibraryPaths.empty() ||
      !isModelIRCacheEnabled()) {
    return loweringTransform();
  }

  WriteableBufferRef keyBuffer =
      makeCacheKey(std::move(file), gcPipelineOptions, graphCompilerOptions);

  // Mojo defines (LOGGING_LEVEL, ASSERT_LEVEL, etc.) must invalidate the cache.
  if (auto *compCtx = impl->maxContext->get<KGEN::CompilationContext>())
    compCtx->print(*keyBuffer);

  return M::cacheMEFTransform("mof", loweringTransform, std::move(keyBuffer));
}

void M::MO::loadDialects(mlir::DialectRegistry &registry) {
  registry.insert<MO::MODialect, MOSH::MOSHDialect, MOGG::MOGGDialect,
                  MGP::MGPDialect, GRT::GRTDialect, RMO::RMODialect,
                  MAP::MAPDialect>();
  M::registerAllKGENDialects(registry);
  M::registerKGENToLLVMTranslation(registry);
}

void M::MO::registerShapeInferencePipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<>(
      "mo-shape-inference", "Run the end-to-end shape inference pipeline.",
      buildShapeInferencePipeline);
}

void M::MO::buildJitPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm) {
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createLowerCompiledRoutines());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createInlineMGPCallsPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createFixupOverhangsPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyChainsPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createOutlineModelsToCallables());
}

namespace {
static void gcPipelineImpl(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                           const GCPipelineOptions &opts, bool skipJit,
                           bool dumpIntermediates = false);
} // namespace

void M::MO::registerGCPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<GCPipelineOptions>(
      "gc-pipeline", "Full graph-compiler pipeline (MO → MGP → JIT).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
        // Enable dumps here so buildGCPipeline stays dump-free for cache keys.
        gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/false,
                       /*dumpIntermediates=*/!getMaxIRDumpDir().empty());
      });
}

void M::MO::registerGCPipelineThroughEmitMojo() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<GCPipelineOptions>(
      "gc-pipeline-pre-jit",
      "Graph compiler through emit-mojo (MO → MGP → emit-mojo; no JIT).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
        gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/true,
                       /*dumpIntermediates=*/!getMaxIRDumpDir().empty());
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMoPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MoPipelineOptions>(
      "mo-pipeline",
      "Passes from graph input up to (but not including) mo-to-mogg.",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MoPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMoPipeline(pm, opts);
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMapPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MapPipelineOptions>(
      "map-pipeline",
      "Passes between mo-to-map and mogg-to-mgp (both excluded).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MapPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMapPipeline(pm, opts);
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMoggPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MoggPipelineOptions>(
      "mogg-pipeline",
      "Passes between mo-to-mogg and mogg-to-mgp (both excluded).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MoggPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMoggPipeline(pm, opts);
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMgpPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MgpPipelineOptions>(
      "mgp-pipeline", "Passes between mogg-to-mgp and jit (both excluded).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MgpPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMgpPipeline(pm, opts);
      });
}

void M::MO::registerJitPipeline() {

LogicalResult MO::runGcPipeline(ModuleOp module,
                                const GCPipelineOptions &gcPipelineOptions) {

  mlir::PassManager pm = mlir::PassManager::on<ModuleOp>(
      module.getContext(), mlir::OpPassManager::Nesting::Implicit);

  if (!gcPipelineOptions.mlirTimingOutDir.empty()) {
    const char *pipelineName = "GC Pipeline";
    auto enabledTiming = M::configureMLIRPassTimingJSONOutput(
        pm, gcPipelineOptions.mlirTimingOutDir.getValue(), pipelineName);
    if (enabledTiming.isError()) {
      llvm::errs() << enabledTiming.getError() << "\n";
      return failure();
    }
  }

  MO::buildGCPipeline(pm, gcPipelineOptions);
  return pm.run(module);
}

void M::MO::buildMoPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                            const MoPipelineOptions &opts) {
  auto kernelLibraryPaths =
      llvm::to_vector_of<std::string>(opts.kernelLibraryPaths);

  // Skipped when the caller already seeded decls and
  // `mogg.opaque_type_mapping` via `MOGG::copyKernelDecls`. RewriteOpaqueTypes
  // still runs so freshly-cloned `!mo.opaque<"simple">` uses get rewritten.
  if (!opts.kernelDeclsPrePopulated) {
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createImportPackages(
        {.mojoPkgPaths = kernelLibraryPaths, .litMlirPaths = {}}));
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createVerifyKernels());
  }

  pm.addPass(MOGG::createRewriteOpaqueTypes());
  pm.addPass(KGEN::createVerifyParameters());

  if (opts.debugPrintAllTensors)
    pm.addPass(MO::createDebugPrintAllTensorsPass());

  pm.addPass(RMO::createLegalizeRMOOps());

  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MO::createCanonicalizeChainSequences());

  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  std::string_view compiledFrameworkLabel;
  if (opts.compiledFrameworkLabel.hasValue())
    compiledFrameworkLabel = opts.compiledFrameworkLabel;

  std::optional<std::string> cacheDir;
  if (opts.cacheDir.hasValue())
    cacheDir = opts.cacheDir;

  if (opts.useShapeInference)
    buildShapeInferencePipeline(pm);

  // TODO(GEX-886): Remove symbolic optimization's dependency on constant
  // folding.
  if (opts.constantFold)
    pm.addPass(MO::createConstantFoldPass(compiledFrameworkLabel, cacheDir,
                                          kernelLibraryPaths));

  pm.addPass(MO::createHoistConstantSubgraphsIntoParent());
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  SymbolicOptimizationOptions symbolicOptimizationOpts;
  symbolicOptimizationOpts.symbolicFfastMath = opts.symbolicFfastMath;
  symbolicOptimizationOpts.symbolicNoUndefinedMath =
      opts.symbolicNoUndefinedMath;

  pm.addPass(MO::createSymbolicOptimization(symbolicOptimizationOpts));
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  pm.addPass(MO::createMergeDuplicateShapeMaterializations());
  pm.addPass(MO::createAddFallbackShapeFunctions());
  pm.addPass(MO::createSymbolicOptimization(symbolicOptimizationOpts));
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  if (opts.constantFold)
    pm.addPass(MO::createConstantFoldPass(compiledFrameworkLabel, cacheDir,
                                          kernelLibraryPaths));

  pm.addPass(MO::createInferLayouts());
  if (opts.usePatterns) {
    MOGG::PatternFusionOptions patternFusionOpts;
    patternFusionOpts.mhaAllowUnsafeBCast =
        opts.patternFusionMHAAllowUnsafeBCasts;
    patternFusionOpts.mhaAllowInternalReshape =
        opts.patternFusionMHAAllowInternalReshape;
    patternFusionOpts.enableMHAPattern = opts.patternFusionMHAEnable;
    patternFusionOpts.targetDevice = opts.defaultDeviceLabel;
    patternFusionOpts.targetDeviceId = opts.defaultDeviceId;
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createPatternFusion(patternFusionOpts));

    InvokeShapePackingFunctionsOptions shapeFuncOptions;
    shapeFuncOptions.sanityCheckShapeFuncs = opts.sanityCheckShapeFuncs;

    pm.addPass(MO::createInvokeShapePackingFunctions(shapeFuncOptions));
    pm.addPass(MO::createPropagateShapes());
    pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
    pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  }

  MO::ValidateDevicesPassOptions validateDevicesPassOpt;
  validateDevicesPassOpt.defaultDeviceTargetTriple =
      opts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple;
  validateDevicesPassOpt.defaultDeviceTargetArch = opts.defaultDeviceTargetArch;
  pm.addPass(MO::createValidateDevicesPass(validateDevicesPassOpt));

  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  // Absorb per-device consumers of an mo.tensor.unbundle back into the
  // producing mo.parallel (canonicalize collapses bundle(unbundle(X)) to X) so
  // epilogue fusion sees a single kernel body.
  pm.addPass(MO::createCreateParallelFromUnbundle());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MO::createMergeAdjacentParallels());

  if (opts.constantFold)
    pm.addPass(MO::createConstantFoldPass(compiledFrameworkLabel, cacheDir,
                                          kernelLibraryPaths));

  if (opts.fuseJitKernels) {
    // Without fusion this can add extraneous copies.
    pm.addPass(MO::createElideRedundantMutableOps());
  }

  pm.addPass(MO::createHoistParameterExpressions());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MO::createRemoveUnusedOps());
}

void M::MO::buildMapPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                             const MapPipelineOptions &opts) {
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createFuseKernels());
  if (opts.fuseMutableLoadStore)
    pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createFuseMutableLoads());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  // After fusion settles, give every fused-output epilogue a real store pointer
  // (plus a pre-cast accumulation buffer for mixed-precision accumulation).
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createAllocateAccumulatingBuffers());

  // An unfused reshape has no MAPToMOGG lowering (its hoisted stride op isn't
  // LowerableToMOGGInterface yet), and an unfused contiguous slice can take the
  // zero-copy path. Raise both back before outlining commits to MAP.
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createRaiseBackContiguousViews());

  pm.addPass(MAP::createOutlineStructuredKernelBodies());
  // Uniques `map.iter.opaque` inputs and captures so the lowered kernel's
  // parameter list is minimal.
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createLoopInvariantViewMotion());
  // CSE before canonicalize: two loads hoisting the same view create identical
  // stride ops; CSE must unify them so DedupeCapturingClosureCaptures can fold
  // the duplicate captures.
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
}

void M::MO::buildMoggPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                              const MoggPipelineOptions &) {
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createLegalizeRowwiseKernels());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createConformCallOperands());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createOutlineRoutines());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createWrapFuncsWithTrace());

  // On the module, not GraphOp: the outlined stubs are its siblings.
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
}

void M::MO::buildMgpPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                             const MgpPipelineOptions &opts) {
  auto kernelLibraryPaths =
      llvm::to_vector_of<std::string>(opts.kernelLibraryPaths);

  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyChainsPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createConcatInPlacePass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createExecInvariantCodeMotionPass());

  // After ExecInvariantCodeMotion: buffer reuse can block hoisting.
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimpleBufferReusePass());

  pm.addPass(MGP::createDynamicMemoryPlanningPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createDeferAllocsPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createVerifyModelArgumentsPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createPredicateAssertDependenciesPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyChainsPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  // Before any fusion.
  pm.addPass(MGP::createAttachPythonStackTraces());

  pm.addPass(MGP::createGlobalizeSlotIndicesPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  MGP::LowerPrimitivesOptions lowerPrimOpts;
  lowerPrimOpts.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
  lowerPrimOpts.minimumCpuAlignment = opts.minimumCpuAlignment;
  pm.addPass(MGP::createLowerPrimitives(lowerPrimOpts));

  {
    pm.addPass(MGP::createStageDeviceGraphsPass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createPartitionDeviceGraphCollectivePass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createComputeDeviceGraphDependenciesPass());
    pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyDeviceGraphDependenciesPass());
    pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
    pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createGenerateBuildGraphStubsPass());
    // Drop the dead launch context chain before finalization audits the
    // builder bridge's live users.
    pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createFinalizeDeviceGraphsPass());
    pm.addPass(mlir::createReconcileUnrealizedCastsPass());
  }

  pm.addPass(MOGG::createSequenceFusion());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyChainsPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyExtendLifetimesPass());

  pm.addPass(MOGG::createOutlineAsyncRoutines());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createLookupConstantResources());

  // Lifting slot-index constants into stub arguments lets kernels differing
  // only in those indices merge below.
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createLiftBufferCacheSlots());

  // The emitted Mojo reads neither device ids nor symbolic dim names, so
  // erasing them lets per-device and per-layer copies merge below.
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createCanonicalizeFuncsForMerge());

  // Stubs that differ only by a redundant op merge once it is gone.
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createMergeIdenticalFuncs());

  // index.constant emits fewer lines of Mojo than its lowered form.
  pm.addPass(MGP::createRaiseBackIndexConstant());

  pm.addPass(MGP::createFixupOverhangsPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MOGG::FuncOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());

  // Drop stubs orphaned by MergeIdenticalFuncs.
  pm.addPass(mlir::createSymbolDCEPass());

  // Before try/except wrapping: the begin/end Trace calls raise, and the
  // MGP-ABI entry point must not.
  if (opts.enableProfileScopeTracing) {
    MOGG::AddProfileScopeTracingOptions profileScopeOptions;
    profileScopeOptions.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled =
        opts.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled;
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createAddProfileScopeTracing(profileScopeOptions));
  }

  // Last, so it sees the final raising set; try/except around non-raising
  // code warns in the Mojo compiler.
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createAddTryExceptBlocks());

  MOGG::EmitMojoOptions emitMojoOptions;
  emitMojoOptions.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
  emitMojoOptions.enableOpTraceComments = opts.enableOpTraceComments;
  emitMojoOptions.enableComputeLambdas = opts.enableComputeLambdas;
  emitMojoOptions.moggDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs =
      opts.moggDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs;
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createEmitMojo(emitMojoOptions));

  if (opts.dumpMojoText)
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createDumpMojo());
}

namespace {

/// Appends every gc-pipeline stage to `pm`. With `dumpIntermediates`, a
/// DumpStagePass runs before the first stage and after each one.
static void gcPipelineImpl(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                           const GCPipelineOptions &opts, bool skipJit,
                           bool dumpIntermediates) {

  auto kernelLibraryPaths =
      llvm::to_vector_of<std::string>(opts.kernelLibraryPaths);

  // Filled by the first ("mo") dump from the non-subgraph model names while
  // the GraphOps still exist; later dumps reuse it.
  auto dumpBaseName = std::make_shared<std::string>();

  if (dumpIntermediates)
    pm.addPass(MO::createDumpStagePass("mo", dumpBaseName));

  MoPipelineOptions moOpts;
  moOpts.debugPrintAllTensors = opts.debugPrintAllTensors;
  moOpts.useShapeInference = opts.useShapeInference;
  moOpts.constantFold = opts.constantFold;
  if (opts.compiledFrameworkLabel.hasValue())
    moOpts.compiledFrameworkLabel = opts.compiledFrameworkLabel.getValue();
  if (opts.cacheDir.hasValue())
    moOpts.cacheDir = opts.cacheDir.getValue();
  moOpts.symbolicFfastMath = opts.symbolicFfastMath;
  moOpts.symbolicNoUndefinedMath = opts.symbolicNoUndefinedMath;
  moOpts.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
  moOpts.kernelDeclsPrePopulated = opts.kernelDeclsPrePopulated;
  moOpts.usePatterns = opts.usePatterns;
  moOpts.patternFusionMHAEnable = opts.patternFusionMHAEnable;
  moOpts.patternFusionMHAAllowUnsafeBCasts =
      opts.patternFusionMHAAllowUnsafeBCasts;
  moOpts.patternFusionMHAAllowInternalReshape =
      opts.patternFusionMHAAllowInternalReshape;
  moOpts.sanityCheckShapeFuncs = opts.sanityCheckShapeFuncs;
  moOpts.defaultDeviceLabel = opts.defaultDeviceLabel;
  moOpts.defaultDeviceId = opts.defaultDeviceId;
  moOpts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple = opts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple;
  moOpts.defaultDeviceTargetArch = opts.defaultDeviceTargetArch;
  moOpts.fuseJitKernels = opts.fuseJitKernels;

  MapPipelineOptions mapOpts;
  mapOpts.fuseMutableLoadStore = opts.fuseMutableLoadStore;

  MoggPipelineOptions moggOpts;

  MGP::MOGGToMGPOptions moToPrimOpts;
  moToPrimOpts.minimumCpuAlignment = opts.minimumCpuAlignment;
  if (opts.compiledFrameworkLabel.hasValue())
    moToPrimOpts.compiledFrameworkLabel = opts.compiledFrameworkLabel;

  MgpPipelineOptions mgpOpts;
  mgpOpts.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
  mgpOpts.minimumCpuAlignment = opts.minimumCpuAlignment;
  mgpOpts.enableOpTraceComments = opts.enableOpTraceComments;
  mgpOpts.enableComputeLambdas = opts.enableComputeLambdas;
  mgpOpts.moggDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs = opts.moggDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs;
  mgpOpts.dumpMojoText = opts.dumpMojoText;
  mgpOpts.enableProfileScopeTracing = opts.enableProfileScopeTracing;
  mgpOpts.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled =
      opts.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled;

  MOGG::JitCompileKernelsOptions jitOpts;
  if (!skipJit) {
    jitOpts.minimumCpuAlignment = opts.minimumCpuAlignment;
    jitOpts.saveTempPrefix = opts.saveTempPrefix;
    jitOpts.createMOGGReproducers = opts.createMOGGReproducers;
    jitOpts.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
    jitOpts.timeMOGGCompile = opts.timeMOGGCompile;
    jitOpts.debugKGENStubs = opts.debugKGENStubs;
    // Cross-compile for the requested GPU instead of probing the host.
    jitOpts.defaultDeviceTargetArch = opts.defaultDeviceTargetArch;
    jitOpts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple = opts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple;
    jitOpts.compileForHostExecution = opts.compileForHostExecution;
  }

  auto buildStage = [&](auto &&build, const std::string &dumpSuffix) {
    build(pm);
    if (dumpIntermediates && !dumpSuffix.empty())
      pm.addPass(MO::createDumpStagePass(dumpSuffix, dumpBaseName));
  };

  buildStage([&](auto &p) { buildMoPipeline(p, moOpts); }, "mo-pre-map");

  // Stable-tensor marking must see MO ops, so it runs as the last MO-level
  // pass before the dialect is lowered away.
  buildStage(
      [&](auto &p) {
        p.addPass(MO::createMarkStableTensorsPass());
        p.addPass(MO::createMOToMAP());
      },
      "mo-to-map");

  buildStage(
      [&](auto &p) {
        buildMapPipeline(p, mapOpts);
        // After MAP fusion so a check never fuses into the kernel it checks;
        // before map-to-mogg so the injected checks compile with the rest.
        if (opts.nanCheck)
          p.addPass(MO::createNanCheckPass(opts.nanCheckStride));
      },
      "map-pre-mogg");

  MAP::MAPToMOGGOptions mapToMoggOpts;
  mapToMoggOpts.enableComputeLambdas = opts.enableComputeLambdas;
  buildStage([&](auto &p) { p.addPass(MAP::createMAPToMOGG(mapToMoggOpts)); },
             "map-to-mogg");

  buildStage(
      [&](auto &p) {
        buildMoggPipeline(p, moggOpts);
        // OpaqueLoc tracebacks can't be printed, so convert them for the
        // dump. Dump-only: this strips the OpaqueLocs buildMgpPipeline's
        // assert handling reads.
        if (dumpIntermediates)
          p.addPass(MGP::createAttachPythonStackTraces());
      },
      "mogg-pre-mgp");

  buildStage([&](auto &p) { p.addPass(MGP::createMOGGToMGP(moToPrimOpts)); },
             "mogg-to-mgp");

  buildStage(
      [&](auto &p) {
        buildMgpPipeline(p, mgpOpts);
        if (!skipJit) {
          p.addPass(MOGG::createJitCompileKernels(jitOpts));
          p.addPass(MOGG::createStripKernelDecls());
          buildJitPipeline(p);
        }
      },
      "mgp");
}

} // namespace

void M::MO::buildGCPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                            const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
  gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/false);
}

void M::MO::buildGCPipelineThroughEmitMojo(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                                           const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
  gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/true);
}

LogicalResult M::MO::runGCPipeline(ModuleOp moduleOp,
                                   const GCPipelineOptions &opts,
                                   bool dumpIntermediates) {
  auto pm = mlir::PassManager::on<ModuleOp>(
      moduleOp.getContext(), mlir::OpPassManager::Nesting::Implicit);

  if (!opts.mlirTimingOutDir.empty()) {
    auto enabledTiming = M::configureMLIRPassTimingJSONOutput(
        pm, opts.mlirTimingOutDir.getValue(), "GC Pipeline");
    if (enabledTiming.isError()) {
      llvm::errs() << enabledTiming.getError() << "\n";
      return failure();
    }
  }

  gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/opts.preJit, dumpIntermediates);
  return pm.run(moduleOp);
}

void M::MO::buildShapeInferencePipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm) {
  // Turns static reshapes like `[D0] -> [1]` into rebinds (so staticization
  // needn't look through them) and materializes parameter definitions for
  // `mo.rebind`s that still declare output parameters.
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());

  // Evaluates constant ops and shape functions in the parameter domain, then
  // simplifies parameter bindings by substitution and constraint solving.
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(MO::createPropagateShapes());
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(KGEN::createVerifyParameters());
}

using BlobMap = DenseMap<const uint8_t *, mlir::AsmResourceBlob *>;

static BlobMap getDenseResources(ModuleOp module) {
  BlobMap result;
  for (Operation &op : module.getOps()) {
    if (auto modelOp = dyn_cast<MGP::ModelOp>(op)) {
      modelOp.walk([&](MGP::BufferConstantOp constOp) {
        auto elementsAttr = constOp.getValue();
        if (auto resourceAttr =
                dyn_cast<DenseResourceElementsAttr>(elementsAttr)) {
          mlir::AsmResourceBlob *blob = resourceAttr.getRawHandle().getBlob();
          if (blob->getDeleter())
            result[blob->getDataAs<uint8_t>().data()] = blob;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  return result;
}

ErrorOr<BufferRef> M::MO::convertMGPToMEF(ModuleOp module,
                                          bool enableMEFMetadata) {
  OwningOpRef<ModuleOp> moduleToRewrite = module.clone();
  // Device-generic ops get renamed with their device label so GraphRT can
  // dispatch to a device-appropriate primitive.
  BlobMap resources = getDenseResources(*moduleToRewrite);
  mlir::PassManager pm = mlir::PassManager::on<ModuleOp>(
      module->getContext(), mlir::OpPassManager::Nesting::Implicit);
  pm.addPass(MGP::createPrepareDevicePrimitivesPass());
  FormatScopedDiagnosticHandler diagnostics(moduleToRewrite->getContext());
  if (failed(pm.run(*moduleToRewrite)))
    return Error(Twine("Failed to prepare MGP model for conversion to MEF. ") +
                 diagnostics.formatMessage());
  ConcatenationTree result =
      translateMLIRToMEF(*moduleToRewrite, enableMEFMetadata);
  if (result.getSize() == 0) {
    return Error(Twine("Failed to convert model to MEF. ") +
                 diagnostics.formatMessage());
  }
  M::WriteableBufferRef outputBuffer = WriteableBuffer::get(
      0, maxAttributeAlignment().value(), result.getSize());
  result.traverse([&](ArrayRef<uint8_t> data) {
    outputBuffer->write(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(data.data()),
                        data.size());
    if (resources.count(data.data())) {
      if (auto blob = resources[data.data()]; blob->getDeleter()) {
        // Free owned blob data as soon as it's been copied out.
        auto ref = M::GML::BlobLifetimeManager(std::move(blob->getDeleter()),
                                               blob->getData(),
                                               blob->getDataAlignment());
        blob->getDeleter() = nullptr;
      }
    }
  });

  return outputBuffer;
}

void EmitMojoState::setFusionStructLoweringFor(Value val, MojoValue instance,
                                               StringLiteral bindMethod,
                                               MojoValue typeName) {
  [[maybe_unused]] auto [it, inserted] = lambdaLowerings.try_emplace(
      val,
      FusionStructInfo{std::move(instance), bindMethod, std::move(typeName)});
  ASSERT_STREAM(inserted, << "value already bound to a lambda lowering");
}

void EmitMojoState::emitOutputStoreFusionDefsOnce() {
  if (emittedOutputStoreFusionArgDefs)
    return;
  structDefsBuilder.verbatim(MojoValue(kOutputStoreFusionDefs.str()));
  emittedOutputStoreFusionArgDefs = true;
}

#define EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(OpTy)                                            \
  LogicalResult emitMojo(OpTy op, EmitMojoState &state);
#define EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(OpTy)                                             \
  if (auto asOp = dyn_cast<OpTy>(op)) {                                        \
    if (emitMojo(asOp, state).failed()) {                                      \
      return op->emitError()                                                   \
             << "'" << op->getName() << "' could not be lowered to Mojo";      \
    }                                                                          \
    return success();                                                          \
  }

EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::AddOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::CastSOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::CmpOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::ConstantOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::BoolConstantOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::DivSOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::DivUOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::CeilDivSOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::CeilDivUOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::MinSOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::MaxSOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::MulOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::RemSOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::RemUOp);

EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::AndOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::AddOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::MulOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::DivOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::CastFromBuiltinOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::CastToBuiltinOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::CmpOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::RemOp);

EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::ShlOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::ShrOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::MinOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::MaxOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::OrOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::XOrOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::SIMDAndOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::SIMDSelectOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::SIMDOrOp);
EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::SIMDXOrOp);

EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::ParamConstantOp);

LogicalResult EmitMojoState::lowerOpToMojo(Operation *op) {
  if (auto emitMojoInterface = dyn_cast<MOGG::EmitsMojoInterface>(op)) {
    if (enableOpTraceComments)
      builder.comment(llvm::formatv("Emitting Mojo for: {0}", op->getName()));

    if (emitMojoInterface.emitMojo(*this).failed()) {
      return emitMojoInterface->emitError()
             << "'" << op->getName() << "' could not be lowered to Mojo";
    }
    return success();
  }

  auto &state = *this;

  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::AddOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::CastSOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::CmpOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::ConstantOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::BoolConstantOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::DivSOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::DivUOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::CeilDivSOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::CeilDivUOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::MinSOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::MaxSOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::MulOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::RemSOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(mlir::index::RemUOp);

  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::AndOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::AddOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::MulOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::DivOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::CastFromBuiltinOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::CastToBuiltinOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::CmpOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::RemOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::SelectOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::ShlOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::ShrOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::MinOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::MaxOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::OrOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::XOrOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::SIMDAndOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::SIMDSelectOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::SIMDOrOp);
  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::POP::SIMDXOrOp);

  EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(KGEN::ParamConstantOp);

  return op->emitError()
         << "'" << op->getName()
         << "' must implement 'EmitsMojoInterface' to lower to Mojo; it is not "
            "a supported 'index' or 'pop' dialect operation either";
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// index dialect implementations
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

LogicalResult emitMojo(mlir::index::AddOp op, EmitMojoState &state) {
  auto operands = state.getMojoValuesFor(op->getOperands());
  state.setMojoValueFor(op.getResult(),
                        state.builder.var(operands[0] + operands[1]));
  return success();
}

LogicalResult emitMojo(mlir::index::CastSOp op, EmitMojoState &state) {
  // TODO: Verify. This op exists in MGP only because pop ops need pop types,
  // not index, so keeping Int is likely fine for MGP's shape-function index
  // math.
  state.setMojoValueFor(op.getResult(), state.getMojoValueFor(op.getInput()));
  return success();
}

LogicalResult emitMojo(mlir::index::CmpOp op, EmitMojoState &state) {
  auto operands = state.getMojoValuesFor(op->getOperands());
  MojoValue replacementValue;
  switch (op.getPred()) {
  case mlir::index::IndexCmpPredicate::EQ:
    replacementValue = operands[0].eq(operands[1]);
    break;
  case mlir::index::IndexCmpPredicate::NE:
    replacementValue = operands[0].neq(operands[1]);
    break;
  case mlir::index::IndexCmpPredicate::SGE:
    replacementValue = operands[0].ge(operands[1]);
    break;
  case mlir::index::IndexCmpPredicate::SGT:
    replacementValue = operands[0].gt(operands[1]);
    break;
  case mlir::index::IndexCmpPredicate::SLE:
    replacementValue = operands[0].le(operands[1]);
    break;
  case mlir::index::IndexCmpPredicate::SLT:
    replacementValue = operands[0].lt(operands[1]);
    break;
  case mlir::index::IndexCmpPredicate::UGE:
    replacementValue = operands[0].ge(operands[1]);
    break;
  case mlir::index::IndexCmpPredicate::UGT:
    replacementValue = operands[0].gt(operands[1]);
    break;
  case mlir::index::IndexCmpPredicate::ULE:
    replacementValue = operands[0].le(operands[1]);
    break;
  case mlir::index::IndexCmpPredicate::ULT:
    replacementValue = operands[0].lt(operands[1]);
    break;
  }
  state.setMojoValueFor(op.getResult(), state.builder.var(replacementValue));

  return success();
}

LogicalResult emitMojo(mlir::index::ConstantOp op, EmitMojoState &state) {
  state.setMojoValueFor(op.getResult(), op.getValue().getSExtValue());
  return success();
}

      op.getResult(),

LogicalResult emitMojo(KGEN::POP::DivOp op, EmitMojoState &state) {
  auto operands = state.getMojoValuesFor(op->getOperands());
  if (op.getType().isFloat()) {
    state.setMojoValueFor(op.getResult(),
                          state.builder.var(operands[0].div(operands[1])));
  } else {
    state.setMojoValueFor(op.getResult(),
                          state.builder.var(operands[0].idiv(operands[1])));

  return success();

LogicalResult emitMojo(KGEN::POP::CmpOp op, EmitMojoState &state) {
  auto operands = state.getMojoValuesFor(op->getOperands());
  MojoValue replacementValue;
  switch (op.getPred()) {
  case KGEN::CmpPredicate::EQ:
    replacementValue = operands[0].eq(operands[1]);
    break;
  case KGEN::CmpPredicate::NE:
    replacementValue = operands[0].neq(operands[1]);
    break;
  case KGEN::CmpPredicate::GE:
    replacementValue = operands[0].ge(operands[1]);
    break;
  case KGEN::CmpPredicate::GT:
    replacementValue = operands[0].gt(operands[1]);
    break;
  case KGEN::CmpPredicate::LE:
    replacementValue = operands[0].le(operands[1]);
    break;
  case KGEN::CmpPredicate::LT:
    replacementValue = operands[0].lt(operands[1]);
    break;
  }
  state.setMojoValueFor(op.getResult(), state.builder.var(replacementValue));

  return success();
}

LogicalResult emitMojo(KGEN::ParamConstantOp op, EmitMojoState &state) {
  if (auto vals = dyn_cast<KGEN::SIMDAttr>(op.getValue())) {
    ASSERT_STREAM(vals, << "Expected a SIMD parameter constant");
    ASSERT_STREAM(vals.getValues().size() == 1,
                  << "Only scalars are supported");
    KGEN::DTypeValue val = vals.getValues().front();
    KGEN::KGENDType valDType = val.getDType();
    if (valDType.isBool())
      state.setMojoValueFor(op.getResult(), val.getBoolVal());
    else
      state.setMojoValueFor(op.getResult(), val.getIntVal());
  } else if (auto val = dyn_cast<IntegerAttr>(op.getValue())) {
    auto apInt = val.getValue();
    if (val.getValue().getBitWidth() == 1) {
      state.setMojoValueFor(op.getResult(), apInt.getBoolValue());
    } else {
      state.setMojoValueFor(
          op.getResult(),
          APSInt(apInt, cast<IntegerType>(val.getType()).isSigned()));
    }
  } else {
    ASSERT_STREAM(false, << "Unsupported param constant type "
                         << op.getValue().getType());
    llvm_unreachable("Unsupported mlir type");
  }

  return success();
}

std::optional<StringRef>
EmitMojoState::getResultParamNameFor(const KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor &fnAdaptor,
                                     StringRef paramName) {
  if (!fnAdaptor.attr.getResultParams())
    return std::nullopt;
  // One entry per result: a {struct-param-name: value} DictionaryAttr if
  // ImportPackages saw the struct's declaration, else a UnitAttr. Only an
  // unresolved value (a ParamDeclRefAttr) has a name to return.
  for (auto resultParam : fnAdaptor.attr.getResultParams()) {
    auto resultParamDict = dyn_cast<DictionaryAttr>(resultParam);
    if (!resultParamDict)
      continue;
    auto attr = resultParamDict.get(paramName);
    if (auto funcParamName = dyn_cast_or_null<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr>(attr))
      return funcParamName.getName();
  }
  return std::nullopt;
}

// Returns the trace name from fusionInfo, or empty string if not set.
static MojoValue getTraceNameValue(FusionInfoAttr fusionInfo) {
  // GEX-979: pass in trace description for fused kernel without
  // invalidating cache.
  if (!fusionInfo)
    return MojoValue("").quote();
  return MojoValue(fusionInfo.toString()).quote();
}

static MojoValue getHasEpilogueFusionValue(mlir::Operation *) {
  // Fused epilogues set `CallOpaqueOp::getHasEpilogueFusion`, which the call's
  // `emitMojo` honors; a kernel without that flag has none.
  return false;
}

ErrorOr<MojoValue> EmitMojoState::inferDefaultKernelParamValue(
    Operation *callOp, StringRef paramName, DictionaryAttr customParamDict) {

  auto inferFromMlirParam = [&](Attribute customParam) -> ErrorOr<MojoValue> {
    // TODO: This conversion is hardcoded and brittle; it needs the parameter
    // type from the kernel infos, not just the name.
    if (auto strAttr = dyn_cast<StringAttr>(customParam))
      return MojoValue(strAttr.getValue()).quote();
    else if (auto boolAttr = dyn_cast<BoolAttr>(customParam))
      return boolAttr.getValue();
    else if (auto intAttr = dyn_cast<IntegerAttr>(customParam))
      // getInt() asserts signless or index; this may be signed (e.g. si32).
      return intAttr.getValue().getSExtValue();
    else if (auto elems = dyn_cast<ElementsAttr>(customParam);
             elems && elems.getShapedType().getRank() == 0 &&
             isa<FloatType>(elems.getElementType())) {
      // A float scalar param is a rank-0 elements attribute (see
      // MO_F32ScalarAttr). `#M.dense_array` only iterates as `Attribute`.
      auto values = elems.tryGetValues<Attribute>();
      auto scalar = values ? dyn_cast<FloatAttr>(*values->begin()) : nullptr;
      if (!scalar || !scalar.getValue().isFinite())
        return Error(
            llvm::formatv("Float param `{}` has no Mojo literal", paramName));
      return MojoValue(scalar.getValue());
    } else if (auto dtypeAttr = dyn_cast<KGEN::DTypeConstantAttr>(customParam))
      return EmitMojoState::mlirDTypeToMojoType(dtypeAttr.getDType());
    else if (auto arrAttr = dyn_cast<ArrayAttr>(customParam);
             arrAttr && !arrAttr.empty() && isa<IntegerAttr>(arrAttr[0])) {
      SmallVector<int64_t> values;
      for (auto val : arrAttr)
        values.push_back(cast<IntegerAttr>(val).getValue().getSExtValue());
      return EmitMojoState::getAsIntTupleMojoValue(values);
    } else
      return Error(llvm::formatv("Unsupported custom param MLIR type for `{}`",
                                 paramName));
  };

  if (auto kernelCallOp = dyn_cast<KernelCallInterface>(callOp);
      kernelCallOp && kernelCallOp.getKernelParams()) {
    if (auto customParam = kernelCallOp.getKernelParams().get(paramName))
      return inferFromMlirParam(customParam);
  }

  if (customParamDict) {
    if (auto customParam = customParamDict.get(paramName))
      return inferFromMlirParam(customParam);
  }

  // Some special parameters are common to all kernels.
  // TODO(GEX-2847): Check the op, not the FuncOp, in case these get
  // sequence fused. Safe today: stubs are outlined before sequence fusion, and
  // sequence-fused ones are all on the host.
  if (paramName == MOGG::kMoggTargetParameterName) {
    auto kernelStubOp = callOp->getParentOfType<FuncOp>();
    return MojoValue(kernelStubOp.getDevice()).quote();
  }
  if (paramName == MOGG::kMoggTraceNameParameterName) {
    auto kernelStubOp = callOp->getParentOfType<FuncOp>();
    return getTraceNameValue(kernelStubOp.getFusionInfoAttr());
  }
  if (paramName == MOGG::kMoggHasEpilogueFusionParameterName)
    return getHasEpilogueFusionValue(callOp);

  return Error(llvm::formatv("Failed to infer parameter `{}`", paramName));
}

MojoValue EmitMojoState::getShapeAsIndexListMojoValue(MOSH::ShapeAttr shapeAttr,
                                                      ValueRange dynamicDims) {
  SmallVector<MojoValue> mojoDims;
  unsigned nextDymDim = 0;
  for (TypedAttr dim : shapeAttr.getValues()) {
    if (auto staticDim = MOSH::ShapeAttr::getStaticDim(dim)) {
      mojoDims.push_back(*staticDim);
    } else {
      ASSERT_STREAM(nextDymDim < dynamicDims.size(),
                    "Missing dynamic dimension");
      mojoDims.push_back(getMojoValueFor(dynamicDims[nextDymDim++]));
    }
  }
  if (mojoDims.empty())
    mojoDims.push_back(MojoValue(static_cast<int64_t>(1)));

  MojoValue rankParam =
      MojoValue(shapeAttr.getRank() == 0 ? 1 : shapeAttr.getRank());

  return MojoValue(kStructIndexList)({rankParam}, mojoDims);
}

MojoValue EmitMojoState::getShapeAsCoordMojoValue(MOSH::ShapeAttr shapeAttr,
                                                  ValueRange dynamicDims) {
  SmallVector<MojoValue> coordElems;
  unsigned nextDynDim = 0;
  for (TypedAttr dim : shapeAttr.getValues()) {
    if (auto staticDim = MOSH::ShapeAttr::getStaticDim(dim)) {
      coordElems.push_back(getComptimeIdx(*staticDim));
    } else {
      // Scalar[DType.int], not Int, to match what the ManagedTensorSlice
      // layout machinery rebinds to.
      ASSERT_STREAM(nextDynDim < dynamicDims.size(),
                    "Missing dynamic dimension");
      MojoValue scalarInt =
          MojoValue(kStructScalar)[MojoValue(kStructDType).get(kEnumDTypeInt)];
      coordElems.push_back(
          scalarInt({}, {getMojoValueFor(dynamicDims[nextDynDim++])}));
    }
  }
  // Rank-0 tensors are represented as rank-1 with a single static `1`.
  if (coordElems.empty())
    coordElems.push_back(getComptimeIdx(1));

  return MojoValue(kStructCoord)({}, coordElems);
}

void EmitMojoState::addDebugPrintTensorSpecs(const MojoValue &tensorValue,
                                             const MojoValue &indicesValue,
                                             bool isInput,
                                             unsigned operandIndex) {
  if (!enableDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs)
    return;

  // We check if all indices are 0 to only print once.
  ManagedTensorSliceRef mts(tensorValue);
  builder.if_(MojoValue(kFnAllZeros)({}, indicesValue), [&]() {
    builder.call(
        kFnPrint, {},
        {MojoValue(isInput ? kParameterInput : kParameterOutput).quote(),
         MojoValue("#" + std::to_string(operandIndex) + ":").quote(),
         MojoValue("shape =").quote(), mts.staticShapeTuple(),
         MojoValue("strides =").quote(), mts.staticStridesTuple(),
         MojoValue("alignment =").quote(), mts.alignment()});
  });
}

void EmitMojoState::addDebugPrintLambdaParam(MOGG::BindLambdaKind lambdaKind,
                                             const MojoValue &widthParam,
                                             const MojoValue &alignmentParam,
                                             const MojoValue &indicesValue) {
  if (!enableDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs)
    return;

  // We check if all indices are 0 to only print once.
  builder.if_(MojoValue(kFnAllZeros)({}, indicesValue), [&]() {
    builder.call(kFnPrint, {},
                 {
                     MojoValue(stringifyBindLambdaKind(lambdaKind)).quote(),
                     MojoValue("width =").quote(),
                     widthParam,
                     MojoValue("alignment =").quote(),
                     alignmentParam,
                 });
  });
}

MojoValue EmitMojoState::mlirOpaqueTypeToMojoType(MO::OpaqueType opaqueType) {
  // ImportPackagesPass already rewrote the symbol to a qualified Mojo name.
  return MojoValue(opaqueType.getSymbol().getValue());
}

SmallVector<MojoValue>
EmitMojoState::getOpaqueTypeParameters(MO::OpaqueType opaqueType) {
  SmallVector<MojoValue> params;
  DictionaryAttr paramDict = opaqueType.getParameters();
  if (!paramDict || paramDict.empty())
    return params;

  for (NamedAttribute param : paramDict) {
    // Emit named parameters like SIMDPair[S0=4, S1=8].
    StringRef name = param.getName().getValue();
    std::string valueStr;
    if (auto intAttr = dyn_cast<IntegerAttr>(param.getValue())) {
      // getInt() asserts signless or index; this may be signed (e.g. si32).
      valueStr = std::to_string(intAttr.getValue().getSExtValue());
    } else {
      // Fallback: use the attribute's string representation.
      llvm::raw_string_ostream ss(valueStr);
      param.getValue().print(ss);
    }
    params.push_back(MojoValue(name.str() + "=" + valueStr));
  }
  return params;
}

using namespace M;
using namespace MO;

// Most ops are async to keep primitives non-blocking (see
// KeyConceptsInGraphRT.md). The exceptions: transpose (TODO(GEX-2569): make
// async after enforcing high water mark), host layout transform, and the
// collectives, which manage their own cross-device parallelism and must
// complete before the runtime proceeds.
bool M::MO::kernelRequiresSyncLaunch(Operation *op) {
  return isa<TransposeOp>(op) || (isOnHost(op) && isa<LayoutTransformOp>(op)) ||
         isa<AllReduceSumOp>(op) || isa<ReduceScatterSumOp>(op) ||
         isa<Composite::AllReduceAddRMSNormQuantFP8Op>(op) ||
         isa<Composite::DistributedMatmulReduceScatterSumOp>(op) ||
         isa<Composite::DistributedReduceScatterRMSNormOp>(op) ||
         isa<Composite::DistributedAllGatherRMSNormOp>(op) ||
         isa<Composite::DistributedAllGatherRMSNormQuantMXFP8Op>(op) ||
         isa<Composite::DistributedAllGatherRMSNormQuantMXFP6Op>(op) ||
         isa<DistributedBroadcastOp>(op) || isa<DistributedScatterOp>(op) ||
         isa<EPDispatchOp>(op) || isa<EPDispatchFP8Op>(op) ||
         isa<EPDispatchBlockScaledNVOp>(op) ||
         isa<EPDispatchBlockScaledNVDynGlobalScalesOp>(op) ||
         isa<EPDispatchMXFP4Op>(op) || isa<EPCombineOp>(op);
}

template <>
std::optional<SmallVector<APInt>>
M::MO::tryGetConstantBlob(mlir::ElementsAttr attr, DType dType) {
  using namespace M::MO::Detail;
  if (auto intElemsAttr = dyn_cast<IntArrayElementsAttr>(attr)) {
    SmallVector<APInt> blob = llvm::map_to_vector(
        intElemsAttr.getValues(), [](const llvm::APInt &elem) { return elem; });
    return blob;
  }

  if (auto denseAttr = dyn_cast<DenseResourceElementsAttr>(attr)) {
    ArrayRef<APInt> data =
        denseAttr.getRawHandle().getBlob()->getDataAs<APInt>();
    return SmallVector<APInt>(data.begin(), data.end());
  }

  return std::nullopt;
}

template <>
std::optional<SmallVector<APFloat>>
M::MO::tryGetConstantBlob(mlir::ElementsAttr attr, DType dType) {
  using namespace M::MO::Detail;
  if (auto floatElemsAttr = dyn_cast<FloatArrayElementsAttr>(attr)) {
    SmallVector<APFloat> blob =
        llvm::map_to_vector(floatElemsAttr.getValues(),
                            [](const llvm::APFloat &elem) { return elem; });
    return blob;
  }

  if (auto denseAttr = dyn_cast<DenseResourceElementsAttr>(attr)) {
    ArrayRef<APFloat> data =
        denseAttr.getRawHandle().getBlob()->getDataAs<APFloat>();
    return SmallVector<APFloat>(data.begin(), data.end());
  }

  return std::nullopt;
}

bool M::MO::isMutableOperand(Value val) {
  return isa<MO::BufferType, MO::OpaqueType>(val.getType());
}

LogicalResult M::MO::checkReshapeShapesCompatible(
    MOSH::ShapeAttr inShape, MOSH::ShapeAttr outShape,
    llvm::function_ref<mlir::InFlightDiagnostic()> emitError) {
  std::optional<int64_t> inNumEles =
      MOSH::ShapeAttr::getStaticDim(inShape.getSymbolicNumElements());
  std::optional<int64_t> outNumEles =
      MOSH::ShapeAttr::getStaticDim(outShape.getSymbolicNumElements());
  if (!inNumEles.has_value() || !outNumEles.has_value())
    return success();

  // Allow one -1 dimension for now, which is a fancy parameter.
  if (*inNumEles < 0 || *outNumEles < 0)
    return success();

  if (*inNumEles != *outNumEles)
    return emitError() << "input and output elements do not match: "
                       << *inNumEles << " vs " << *outNumEles;
  return success();
}

ErrorOr<int64_t> M::MO::getReductionAxis(Value input, TypeRange results) {
  auto inputTy = dyn_cast<TensorType>(input.getType());
  if (!inputTy || !inputTy.hasRank())
    return Error("needs a ranked tensor input");
  MOSH::ShapeAttr inShape = inputTy.getShape();

  std::optional<int64_t> axis;
  for (Type type : results) {
    auto resultTy = dyn_cast<TensorType>(type);
    if (!resultTy || !resultTy.hasRank() ||
        resultTy.getRank() != inputTy.getRank())
      return Error("results must be tensors of the input's rank");
    MOSH::ShapeAttr outShape = resultTy.getShape();
    SmallVector<int64_t> changed;
    for (int64_t d = 0, e = inShape.getRank(); d < e; ++d)
      if (outShape[d] != inShape[d])
        changed.push_back(d);
    if (changed.size() != 1 ||
        MOSH::ShapeAttr::getStaticDim(outShape[changed.front()]) != 1)
      return Error("must turn exactly one input dimension into 1");
    if (axis && *axis != changed.front())
      return Error("results reduce different axes");
    axis = changed.front();
  }
  if (!axis)
    return Error("has no results");
  return *axis;
}
